claims.assertion: Mari describes Saska 1 and Toleka docking with gravity engines, a telescoping connector and clamps for supply transfer.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She calls it delicate and unshielded.

claims.assertion: A Scimitair jammed between the ships, lowering their orbit and preventing engine burns until they synchronized low-power burns.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: The ships risked violating the First Directive if seen from Earth.

claims.assertion: Releasing the fighter caused a blast that damaged Toleka’s hangar and life-support lines; exterior shields retained pressure, and Saska 1 aided repairs.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Mari says no one was injured.

coverage_gaps: fighter replacement details and subsequent repair status omitted
